constraint_results.judge_reason: The code implements both required behaviors: (1) It recursively redacts nested dicts through the redact_nested() helper function which checks isinstance(value, dict) and recursively processes nested dictionaries at any depth, redacting sensitive keys via self.is_sensitive().
